description: React component for a resizable right-hand side panel in a Mattermost web application, including resize handling, overlap logic, and UI interactions.

methods.name: handleResize
methods.description: Handles resize events, updating the width CSS variable if overlap is not required.

methods.name: handleResizeEnd
methods.description: Removes the width CSS variable after resize ends.

methods.name: handleDividerDoubleClick
methods.description: Resets width and toggles layout-changing class on body for double-click resize reset.
